title: Listening Drill — Lost event badge
description: Customer service dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Lost event badge
sections.transcript:
CUSTOMER: I need some help with an event badge. The main problem is the name faded. I thought I could solve it myself, but the instructions don't cover what I've seen.

ADVISER: We can look into it. First please send the registration email. Then bring the item to the badge desk. If you go to the original collection point they will send you back here.

CUSTOMER: What happens if you can't sort it out while I'm there?

ADVISER: Ask for a new badge. wait until your name is called. Keep the confirmation until the issue has been closed.
